mapper.sql: select r.record_id, r.material_id, r.asset_code, r.record_type, r.quantity, r.operator, r.operate_time, r.from_warehouse_id, r.to_warehouse_id, r.target_person, r.reason, r.status, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, m.material_name, m.material_code, m.unit, w1.warehouse_name as from_warehouse_name, w2.warehouse_name as to_warehouse_name from biz_asset_record r left join biz_material m on r.material_id = m.material_id left join biz_warehouse w1 on r.from_warehouse_id = w1.warehouse_id left join biz_warehouse w2 on r.to_warehouse_id = w2.warehouse_id
mapper.select: where r.material_id = #{materialId} order by r.operate_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_asset_record( material_id, asset_code, record_type, quantity, operator, operate_time, from_warehouse_id, to_warehouse_id, target_person, reason, status, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{materialId}, #{assetCode}, #{recordType}, #{quantity}, #{operator}, #{operateTime}, #{fromWarehouseId}, #{toWarehouseId}, #{targetPerson}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
